name: envenox-web
description: Envenox — cybersecurity services and custom software engineering.

scripts.build: npm run check && next build && node scripts/post-export.mjs
scripts.check: npm run check:icons && npm run check:motion && npm run check:animations && npm run check:placeholders && npm run typecheck
scripts.check:deploy: npm run check:icons && npm run check:motion && npm run check:animations && npm run check:placeholders:strict && npm run typecheck
scripts.cf:preview: npm run build && wrangler dev -c wrangler.static.jsonc
scripts.cf:deploy: npm run check:deploy && next build && node scripts/post-export.mjs && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.jsonc
scripts.cf:deploy:staging: npm run check:deploy && next build && node scripts/post-export.mjs && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.static.jsonc
